checks.criterion: El menú principal muestra un botón visible para opiniones
checks.name: feedback-button-visible-in-menu
checks.evidence: getByTestId('feedback-open-button') visible in desktop menu with text 'DEJA TU OPINIÓN'; screenshot captured.

checks.criterion: El botón abre un modal amplio sin abandonar el juego
checks.name: feedback-modal-opens-without-navigation
checks.evidence: Clicking feedback-open-button shows role=dialog testid='feedback-modal' titled 'Deja tu opinión'; page.url() unchanged before/after click.

checks.criterion: El modal incrusta el Padlet solicitado
checks.name: feedback-modal-embeds-padlet-iframe
checks.evidence: iframe testid='padlet-iframe' visible with src exactly 'https://padlet.com/tresazulxre23/opiniones-del-juego-seaweed-s0238bxxb1ij9a9vpgkf' and non-empty accessible title attribute.

checks.name: test_padlet_board_responds_200_with_expected_title
checks.evidence: GET https://padlet.com/tresazulxre23/opiniones-del-juego-seaweed-s0238bxxb1ij9a9vpgkf -> 200; response body contains 'seaweed'/'opiniones'. pytest: 1 passed in 0.88s.

checks.criterion: El modal ofrece cierre y respaldo externo
checks.name: feedback-modal-close-and-external-link
checks.evidence: padlet-external-link href matches PADLET_URL with target='_blank'; clicking feedback-modal-close removes feedback-modal (toHaveCount(0)).

checks.criterion: El juego sigue sin consumir API propia
checks.name: feedback-modal-no-own-api-calls
checks.evidence: Network requests captured during open/close of feedback modal; requests to own /api/* (excluding padlet.com) list was empty ([]).
